Name: Mini Bars Text - Monster Health Mod
Author: jhj0411jhj
Description:
[size=6]Mini Bars Text[/size]

A text-based monster health bar mod for Stardew Valley, modified from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8329]Coldopa's Mini Bars Mod[/url].
[size=5]
Features
[/size]
[list]
[*]Display monster health as text above their heads.
[*]Works in both single-player and local co-op multiplayer games. Online multiplayer is not tested but should work.
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]﻿ for easy configuration.
[*]  - Configurable health colors (with gradient support using HSL algorithm, from full health to low health).
[*]  - Configurable background color (RGBA).
[*]  - Option to hide health bar when monster is at full health.
[*]  - Option to enable range verification.
[/list]
[size=5]Credits[/size]

[list]
[*]**Mini Bars** by Coldopa
[*]  - NexusMods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8329]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8329[/url]﻿
[*]  - GitHub: [url=https://github.com/Coldopa/Mini-Bars]https://github.com/Coldopa/Mini-Bars[/url]﻿
[/list]
This mod is a modified version of the original **Mini Bars** mod.
The original mod displays monster health as health bar image while this mod displays it as text.
You may choose to use either mod depending on your preference.

[list]
[*]**Display Monster Health** by atesba
[*]  - NexusMods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20984]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20984[/url]﻿
[/list]
This mod is also inspired by **Display Monster Health**, which is a closed-source mod that works perfectly in single-player games but has multiplayer display issues (version 1.3.0).

This mod supports single-player and local co-op multiplayer games. Online multiplayer is not tested but should work.

[size=5]Installation[/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
2. (Optional but recommended) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] for easy configuration.
3. Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=5]Configuration[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] is recommended or you can directly edit `config.json` file.

- `Hide_On_Full_Health`: Hide health bar when monster is at full health
- `Range_Verification`: Enable range verification
- `Background_Color_R/G/B/A`: Background color (Red, Green, Blue, Alpha)
- `Full_Health_Color_R/G/B`: Color for full health
- `Empty_Health_Color_R/G/B`: Color for low health
